info.title: fuse
info.description: Local compiler-backed verification and typed .NET wiring for AI coding agents. Typecheck proposed edits, compute change impact, run covering tests, and stage verified refactors. Persistent scoped context supports these outcomes.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Fuse: local compiler-backed verification and typed .NET wiring for AI agents.

options.name: --help

options.name: --version

commands.name: capture
commands.description: Build once and package a portable capture bundle (compiler log + graph + manifest) so another machine gets oracle-grade answers without building. Fail-closed secret scan; never ships the binary log.

options.name: --out
options.description: The output bundle directory (created if absent). Holds the manifest, the portable compiler log, and the extracted graph. [default: fuse-capture]

options.name: --merge
options.description: Assemble a bundle by merging per-project fragment binary logs in this directory (the build-target channel, G4), instead of building the workspace. Produces a format-2 bundle equal in graph to a direct capture.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The workspace directory to capture. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

commands.name: check
commands.description: Ambient verification: print the diagnostics this session's edits introduced or resolved since the baseline, from the running host. Silent when nothing changed or no host is serving. Never builds.

options.name: --delta
options.description: Report the diagnostics introduced or resolved since the session baseline (the default and only mode). [default: False]

options.name: --session
options.description: The check-session id (defaults to 'hook'; the store is per-repository, so one id per repo is enough). [default: hook]

options.name: --fast
options.description: Use a shorter connect probe (hook mode). [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The workspace directory. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

commands.name: context
commands.description: Plan the context (files, roles, tiers, provenance) for a set of seeds.

options.name: --seed
options.description: A named seed (symbol/service/request/config). Repeatable. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --route
options.description: A route seed ("POST /api/orders/{id}"). Repeatable. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --depth
options.description: Graph expansion depth. [default: 2]

options.name: --max-tokens
options.description: Token budget.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: xml (default), markdown, or json. [default: xml]

options.name: --plan-only
options.description: Print the plan without rendering source bodies. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The workspace directory. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

commands.name: diagnostics
commands.description: Report the index state for a workspace (schema, mode, counts, store location).

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The workspace directory. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Diagnose the semantic load: the achieved tier and the per-project reason for any downgrade.

options.name: --refresh
options.description: Force a live MSBuild load diagnosis instead of reporting the warm index's stamped diagnosis (R43). [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The workspace directory. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

commands.name: find
commands.description: Find indexed code by exact lookup, wiring, graph neighborhood, or task.

options.name: --path
options.description: The workspace directory. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

options.name: --kind
options.description: Kind: symbol, path, text, all, service, request, route, config, signatures, neighbors, or task. [default: all]

options.name: --changed-since
options.description: A Git base ref whose changed files seed task candidates.

options.name: --max-candidates
options.description: Maximum task candidates or graph neighbors to return. [default: 50]

options.name: --strict
options.description: Refuse task localization with insufficient signal and return its navigation map. [default: False]

options.name: --expand
options.description: Add graph neighbors to task candidates. [default: False]

arguments.name: QUERY
arguments.description: The name, path fragment, text, wiring identifier, or task to find. [default: ]

commands.name: gate
commands.description: Ambient-verification gate: exit nonzero (with the red summary) while this session has introduced compiler errors, for use as a Stop hook. Exits 0 when clean, when only pre-existing errors remain, or when no host is serving.

options.name: --session
options.description: The check-session id (defaults to 'hook'). [default: hook]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The workspace directory. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

commands.name: host
commands.description: Run the Fuse host: serve the warm engine to ambient-verification hooks over a named pipe or Unix socket.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root to serve. Defaults to the current directory. [default: <path>]

commands.name: impact
commands.description: Blast radius for a symbol before you edit it (callers, implementers, consumers, referencing types), from the persisted graph. Package-upgrade mode diffs two cached NuGet versions.

options.name: --path
options.description: The workspace directory. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum impacted items to return. [default: 50]

options.name: --package
options.description: Package-upgrade mode: the NuGet package id whose bump to analyze. [default: ]

options.name: --from-version
options.description: Package-upgrade mode: the currently referenced version. [default: ]

options.name: --to-version
options.description: Package-upgrade mode: the target (upgrade) version. [default: ]

arguments.name: SYMBOL
arguments.description: The symbol (simple or qualified name) whose blast radius to compute. [default: ]

commands.name: index

options.name: --force

options.name: --from-capture

options.name: --json

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The workspace directory to index. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

commands.name: cancel

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit one JSON cancellation object. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The workspace directory. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

commands.name: clean

options.name: --yes

arguments.name: PATH

options.name: --json

arguments.name: PATH

commands.name: init

commands.name: map

options.name: --detail

options.name: --max-rows

arguments.name: PATH

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Manage the Fuse Model Context Protocol server: install, doctor, and serve.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Write MCP client registration and managed Fuse guidance for launching 'fuse mcp serve'.

options.name: --client
options.description: AI client: claude, cursor, copilot, opencode, kilo, codex, grok, or all (default: all). [default: all]

options.name: --scope
options.description: Config scope: project (the enclosing Git repository) or user (the client's user config). This does not change index scope. [default: project]

options.name: --command
options.description: Executable the client launches (default: the running fuse binary or fuse on PATH).

options.name: --no-rules
options.description: Register MCP only. Do not write managed Fuse instructions to AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or the client's documented equivalent. [default: False]

options.name: --with-hooks
options.description: Also write Claude Code ambient-verification hooks (PostToolUse -> fuse check --delta, Stop -> fuse gate) into project .claude/settings.json. [default: False]

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Inspect MCP registration, managed guidance, daemon reachability, and index job state.

options.name: --client
options.description: AI client: claude, cursor, copilot, opencode, kilo, codex, grok, or all (default: all). [default: all]

options.name: --scope
options.description: Config scope: project (the enclosing Git repository) or user (the client's user config). [default: project]

options.name: --with-hooks
options.description: Also inspect project-scoped Claude Code ambient-verification hooks. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit one JSON diagnostic object. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Directory to inspect. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Start the Fuse MCP server for AI agent integration. Communicates via stdio using the Model Context Protocol.

commands.name: reduce
commands.description: Reduce specific files (--files) or piped content (--stdin) and print the compacted result to stdout.

options.name: --files
options.description: File paths to reduce (space-separated). Mutually exclusive with --stdin.

options.name: --stdin
options.description: Read content to reduce from stdin instead of files. Mutually exclusive with --files. [default: False]

options.name: --ext
options.description: Extension that selects the reducer for --stdin content (for example .cs, .ts, .py). [default: .cs]

options.name: --level
options.description: C# reduction level: none, standard, aggressive, skeleton, publicApi. [default: Standard]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Base directory for resolving relative --files paths. [default: <path>]

options.name: --max-tokens
options.description: Maximum tokens the reduced output may use (0 = no limit).

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review the semantic impact of a change since a git base ref.

options.name: --changed-since
options.description: The git base ref to diff against (branch, commit, or HEAD~N). [default: HEAD]

options.name: --max-tokens
options.description: Token budget.

options.name: --include-tests
options.description: Include related test files. [default: True]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: xml (default), markdown, or json. [default: xml]

options.name: --plan-only
options.description: Print the preamble and plan without rendering source bodies. [default: False]

options.name: --handoff
options.description: Produce a paste-ready PR handoff packet (changed files, API delta, compiler-gate status, residual risk) instead of the review context. [default: False]

options.name: --check-session
options.description: For --handoff: the fuse_check session id to gate on (refuses while it has unresolved introduced errors). [default: ]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The workspace directory. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

commands.name: test
commands.description: Run the covering tests for a symbol (the tests that reach it via the persisted tests edges) at build grade, scoped so the whole suite never runs.

options.name: --path
options.description: The workspace directory. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum covering test types to run. [default: 20]

arguments.name: SYMBOL
arguments.description: The symbol whose covering tests to run. [default: ]

commands.name: up
commands.description: Report the environment-remediation plan: per-project failures, the remedy that would fix each, and the workable subset. Report-only for now; applies nothing and never edits the repository.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Apply the install-free remedies (the NU1507 overlay restore) and re-attempt the load. Consent-gated installs still require --allow-install and are only reported. Never edits the repository. [default: False]

options.name: --allow-install
options.description: Consent to the machine-changing install remedies (SDK, workload). Off by default; without it those remedies are reported, never run. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the machine-readable JSON report (per-project tier, remedy, workable-subset) instead of the human-readable text. [default: False]

options.name: --probe
options.description: Run a real dotnet build to probe tier-1 (build-capture) reachability. Surfaces restore/build failures (NU1507, NETSDK1045, MSB4018) the design-time load cannot, and classifies the blocker. Slower (a full build); off by default. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The workspace directory. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update the Fuse global tool (stops running hosts, then updates once this process exits).

options.name: --to-version
options.description: The exact version to install (default: latest stable).

options.name: --force-kill-peers
options.description: Stop every Fuse peer on the machine before updating. [default: False]

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify against what CI will run. With --ci-parity: extract the workflows' dotnet command sequence, classify the steps that cannot be rehearsed locally (secrets, package push), and with --run execute the rehearsable ones through the local executor.

options.name: --ci-parity
options.description: Rehearse the repository's CI dotnet steps and classify the non-rehearsable ones. [default: False]

options.name: --run
options.description: Execute the rehearsable dotnet commands locally (otherwise the sequence is only printed). [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The workspace directory. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

commands.name: warm
commands.description: Warm the persistent index for a workspace now, so the next read is fast (syntax-first build; a warm store is a no-op).

options.name: --service
options.description: Manage the opt-in always-on warm service: install, uninstall, or status. [default: ]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The workspace directory to warm. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]
